rationale: Both acceptance criteria hold at this pin and the suite is green at 439/439 — every agent-facing surface scans clean and the internal ids survive in steps.ts, analytics.ts and cli.ts — but the revision changed no code (revisedBranchHead equals basedOn equals the original implementation), so the blind spot my comparison proved is still shipping: test/agentLanguage.test.ts:395 filters the hook walk to *.sh, which skips githooks/pre-commit, pre-push, post-merge, post-commit and commit-msg (27 of the 35 emitting lines and the only stderr an agent sees on a blocked commit), while the expect(walked.length).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(8) guard on the line above is satisfied by the very files the loop skips; appending echo "the current step is gated by R6" to githooks/pre-commit at this pin still passes 15/15, so deleting line 395 — and, separately, replacing the git show :AGENTS.md subprocess at line 321 with the in-process removeManagedBlock strip so the fixture stops depending on mutable index state — are the two one-line changes that close an audit gap of exactly the kind this issue exists to remove.
